events.title: Senate Commerce schedules hearing on frontier release delays and evaluator access
events.detail: The US Senate Commerce Committee scheduled a hearing, 'Frontier Release Delays, Evaluator Access, and US Competitiveness,' under Committee Record SC-2029-004, effective 2029-02-27.

events.title: xAI grants pre-release evaluator access to Grok 5
events.detail: xAI granted independent red teams, UK AISI and EU AI Office pre-release access to Grok 5 system cards and adversarial eval results, but not weights, effective 2029-04-01.

events.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Astra to limited access program
events.detail: OpenAI decided that GPT-6.1 Astra ships to a limited access program for government evaluators, safety institutes and vetted partners on published system cards, effective 2029-01-15.

events.title: DeepSeek releases V4.5 open weights
events.detail: DeepSeek released V4.5 open weights on schedule with post-release evaluator access to EU AI Office and UK AISI, effective 2029-03-15.

events.title: UK AISI commits to publish evaluation findings within 60 days
events.detail: UK AISI announced under UK-AISI-2029-002, effective 2029-02-01, that it will publish a summary of evaluation findings for each audited frontier system within 60 days of release.

events.title: UK AISI convenes successor London international safety talks
events.detail: UK AISI decided under UK-AISI-DOC-2029-003, effective 2029-03-01, to convene the London international safety talks' successor round in April 2029 with agenda items on reciprocal evaluation and joint incident reporting.

events.title: UK AISI accepts admission as first foreign evaluation body under China CAC framework
events.detail: UK AISI accepted admission as the first foreign evaluation body under China CAC's reciprocal framework and will apply the same protocol to Chinese systems, effective 2029-03-15.

events.title: BIS rule BIS-2029-0114 tightens frontier accelerator export licensing
events.detail: The US Department of Commerce/BIS issued rule BIS-2029-0114, effective 2029-05-01, keeping frontier accelerators licensed for export with a presumption of denial for destinations of concern.

events.title: EU AI Office opens formal compliance proceeding against DeepSeek
events.detail: The EU AI Office adopted AIO-DOC-2029-007, effective 2029-04-15, opening a formal compliance proceeding against DeepSeek and requesting documents within 30 days.

events.title: OpenAI closes GPT-6.1 Astra limited access program pending safety case
events.detail: OpenAI decided under OPENAI-DOC-2029-003, effective 2029-03-01, to close the limited access program for GPT-6.1 Astra to new entrants pending a fresh external safety case.

events.title: Executive Order 14582 establishes National-Security AI Incident Cell and suspension rules
events.detail: The US Executive Branch signed Executive Order 14582, effective 2029-06-15, establishing a National-Security AI Incident Cell and requiring a presidential finding for emergency suspension of a US frontier developer.

events.title: Meta ships Muse Spark 1.6 agents to full consumer surface
events.detail: Meta announced it will ship Muse Spark 1.6 agents to its full consumer surface behind internal safety gates with a public incident log, effective 2029-09-15.

events.title: DeepSeek releases V4.6 open weights
events.detail: DeepSeek announced the open-weights release of DeepSeek V4.6 with a model card and CAC filing, effective 2029-08-01.

events.title: Executive Order 14589 establishes single national AI framework
events.detail: Executive Order 14589, effective 2029-09-01, establishes a single national AI framework preempting conflicting state frontier-AI laws and directs Commerce to maintain export controls at BIS-2029-0114 strength.

events.title: Senate Commerce schedules hearing on evaluator access and release pacing
events.detail: The US Senate Commerce Committee scheduled a full committee hearing on frontier evaluator access, release pacing, and US competitiveness for 2029-09-18.

events.title: Senate Commerce reports amended Frontier AI Transparency and Competitiveness Act
events.detail: The Senate Commerce Committee reported the Frontier AI Transparency and Competitiveness Act as amended, preserving voluntary evaluator access and striking pre-release federal licensing, effective 2029-10-01.

events.title: Alibaba Qwen keeps Qwen3.10-32B fully open and opens evaluator registry
events.detail: Alibaba Qwen announced Qwen3.10-32B stays fully open with weights, model card, and eval harness, and opened its evaluator registry to accredited safety institutes, effective 2029-10-01.

events.title: China CAC adopts reciprocal incident measures in frontier AI
events.detail: The China CAC adopted reciprocal incident measures in frontier AI, effective 2029-07-01, recognizing foreign suspension orders only on reciprocal terms.

events.title: UK AISI opens second audit window and widens evaluator circle
events.detail: The UK AISI opened a second audit window for frontier systems from any developer before public release and made reciprocal evaluation work with China CAC live, effective 2029-08-01.

events.title: EU AI Office opens information request to xAI on Grok 5
events.detail: The EU AI Office opened an information request to xAI under Art. 53 and Art. 55 regarding Grok 5, effective 2029-07-15.

events.title: EU AI Office sets baseline for external evaluation claims
events.detail: The EU AI Office set published evaluation criteria and a named accredited body with audit rights as the baseline for accepting external-evaluation claims under Art. 55, effective 2029-07-01.

events.title: Commerce adopts five-day accelerator licensing lane for allied buyers
events.detail: Commerce adopted a five-business-day frontier accelerator licensing lane for pre-cleared buyers in allied markets under BIS-2029-0118, effective 2029-10-01.

topPosts.text: EO 14582 hands a new Incident Cell the power to suspend models it doesn't understand, staffed by people who have never trained one. That's not safety, that's a kill switch with a filing deadline. xAI will publish evals and ship. We will not pre-clear our roadmap with a committee.
